archive.recipe: git archive --format=tar --prefix=boltz-cb04aecc/ cb04aeccdd480fd4db707f0bbafde538397fa2ac src/boltz pyproject.toml LICENSE README.md | gzip -n -9

upstream.install: pip install --no-deps stock/boltz-2.2.1-py3-none-any.whl   (or: pip install --no-deps stock/boltz-cb04aecc.tar.gz; or: pip install boltz==2.2.1)

installed_tree.recipe: sha256 over the concatenated bytes of sorted(glob('<site-packages>/boltz/**/*.py', recursive=True)); the wheel's boltz/ tree and src/boltz at cb04aecc are byte-identical (107 files)

upstream.license: MIT (LICENSE at cb04aecc: Copyright (c) 2024 Jeremy Wohlwend, Gabriele Corso, Saro Passaro)

weights.upstream_reads_env: boltz.main.get_cache_path (main.py:262-278): BOLTZ_CACHE, else ~/.boltz; `--cache` on the command line overrides

mols.tar.unpacked_to: mols/ (checked for presence; the archive carries the digest)

pinned_stack.torch_source: PyTorch cu130 wheel (nvidia-*-cu13 / nvidia-* 13.x runtime wheels per the freeze)
pinned_stack.tested_on: NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 with this stack (environment/requirements.lock)

full_freeze: environment/requirements.lock (pip freeze --all of the tested stack: the pinned stack plus pip, setuptools, wheel)

declared_requirements.source: pyproject.toml at cb04aecc (23 dependencies, requires-python >=3.10,<3.13; no Dockerfile, lock or conda file in the tree)
declared_requirements.cuda_extra: cuequivariance_ops_cu12>=0.5.0, cuequivariance_ops_torch_cu12>=0.5.0, cuequivariance_torch>=0.5.0 (the freeze carries the cu13 builds 0.10.0 instead)

system.compiler: gcc/cc + Python headers required at run time for the Triton kernels (the flash triangle attention and the fused cells); without them those levers are inert (kit fallback)

cli_defaults.source: main.py:818-1041 (click options), predict() defaults main.py:1042-1080; checkpoint / affinity_checkpoint / method None = not given; preprocessing_threads None = main.py's own default (multiprocessing.cpu_count() of the box; the worker parses one input per child, 1 thread)

stock_environment.note: every entry is a name prefix: the kits' switch families (BOLTZ_LEVERS / BOLTZ_GRAPH_* / BOLTZ_DIT_* / BOLTZ_TRIATTN* / BOLTZ_CHUNK / BOLTZ_XL* / BOLTZ_FPF_* / FPF_* / PF_* / PTX_TRIATTN_*; the pair-track adapters' BOLTZ_PAIRBLOCK* / BOLTZ_TRANSITION*; the BOLTZ2-FASTER levers' BOLTZ_SAMPLER_* / BOLTZ_TRIMUL_* / BOLTZ_ATOM* / BOLTZ_WASTE* / BOLTZ_EXACTLN* / BOLTZ_PAIRFUSE* / BOLTZ_MSA2* / BOLTZ_CONF* — BOLTZ_GRAPH_TRUNK* and BOLTZ_DIT_EXACT* fall under BOLTZ_GRAPH_* / BOLTZ_DIT_* — and the core's pair-fused candidate gate OPT_CORE_PF_*; never the stock's own BOLTZ_MSA_USERNAME / BOLTZ_MSA_PASSWORD reads: BOLTZ_MSA2 is a full-word prefix), the row-sharding line's words (BOLTZ_TP, ROWPAIR_TAG, and the ROWPAIR_* placement / kernel / sync words of modes.TP_EXPORTS — the mode's row sets them; a caller's copy never reaches the worker or the stock process), the cuEquivariance tuning words (CUEQ_*), the harness-era BZ_* words, the package's own BOLTZ2_OPT*, the derived MODEL_OPT_STACK_KEY and the retired count words BOLTZ_OPM_ROWS / BOLTZ_RECYCLING_STEPS / BOLTZ_SAMPLING_STEPS
